recommendation: Retain bounded emission. DeepSeek incremental17.78% allocation saving with0.55% replay elapsed increase versus historical M3 is worthwhile; ordinary binary saves64KiB, other allocations are flat. Preserve limits and do not widen search to force gains.
diagnostic_limitations: absent_predecessors counts eligible target objects carrying no prior IDs at encoder entry; it includes Init, absent/no-overlap predecessors and exhausted correspondence. It is not an exact count of files lacking a retained predecessor. Correspondence skips are separately counted.
Metadata objects use FULL; original payload spans supply current optional delta hints. Not every same-role metadata opportunity is searched.
Per-record compressed storage attribution is unavailable. A/B totals describe encoded groups, with B only for eligible groups; subtracting global A and global B is not a saving equation.
Candidate membership SQL count and matching-only base bytes are not separately instrumented; physical reads include ordinary, duplicate, correspondence and base activity.
